title: MyJewl manufacturing evidence record v0.1
description: What a named person said about a manufacturing limit, when they said it, and under what scope. This is TESTIMONY INTAKE, not calibration. A declared finding may become an uncalibrated CANDIDATE floor -- the column a casting shop is asked to pick from -- and nothing more. It can never set calibrated=True, never supersede a ShopProfile, and never move a geometry gate. Only a calibrated shop profile plus human jeweler review does that.

status.description: 'declared' asserts a real human read and confirmed this record. An undeclared record refuses every one of its own findings.

certifies_manufacturing.description: Structurally pinned. Testimony is never a manufacturing certification.

name.description: Who transcribed this record. Not who said it -- that is per-finding attribution.

findings.description: Keyed by the manufacturing floor the answer bears on, e.g. min_castable_wire_diameter_mm.

value_mm.description: A single figure, when one was given. Null when the answer was a range or was qualitative.

range_mm.description: Preferred over value_mm when the answer was a band. Both ends become candidate floors, because a band's low end is the interesting one.

evidence_class.description: NONE of these calibrates. A shop MEASURING its own process is a ShopProfile, not an evidence class here -- that distinction is the whole point of the file.

name.description: The person who said it. Empty string means unattributed, which is refused.

role.description: e.g. 'bench jeweler, 30 years', 'casting house owner'. Their standing is why the number is worth anything.

heard_on.description: When it was said. Undated testimony is refused.

alloy_scope.description: Which alloys the answer covers. Empty means the speaker did not distinguish, which is recorded as-is rather than assumed universal.

process_scope.description: A fabricated-prong minimum is NOT a cast-prong minimum. Unknown is refused, because conflating them is exactly the error the brief warns about.

measurement_basis.description: MyJewl ships finished-nominal geometry, so a pre-finishing minimum is not directly comparable. Unknown is refused.

verbatim.description: What they actually said, as close to word-for-word as possible. Paraphrase loses the hedges, and the hedges are the information.
